CDC estimates that 1 in 20 kids in the US has an FASD; however, resources for diagnosis and treatment are extremely limited. We are here to help change that by raising awareness about FASD, promoting interdisciplinary collaboration, and supporting local FASD advocacy efforts.

description: Women of Cinematic Arts is a School of Cinematic Arts (SCA) organization dedicated to changing the landscape of Hollywood by socially & professionally supporting female and nonbinary USC students behind and in front of the camera, through the lens of intersectional feminism.

name: Women’s & Freestyle Wrestling Club
description: Women’s & Freestyle Wrestling Club aims to facilitate the growth of women’s wrestling and empower our athletes to succeed in the sport. We all welcome women (trans and non-binary inclusive) and those who want to learn freestyle wrestling, regardless of prior experience.

name: Women's Club Basketball at USC
description: The Women's Club Basketball team was officially founded 10 years ago and has been competitive ever since, winning 3 Regional Championships, including one in 2022, traveling to Nationals 4 times, and winning 1 National Basketball Championship in 2016!

name: Women's Club Water Polo at USC
description: Formed in 2004, Women's Club Water Polo is an official club sport at the University of Southern California competing in the Pacific Coast Division of the Collegiate Water Polo Association.

name: Women's Ice Hockey
description: Women's Ice Hockey was founded at the University of Southern California over 15 years ago, to spread the love of the best sport in the world and to provide an inclusive and welcoming environment for learning it. Throughout its illustrious history, WICE has attracted women of all backgrounds, majors, and experience levels, and we continue that legacy today. Our team thrives on dedication, perseverance, and sportsmanship, and we work hard to foster a strong community with unbeatable team chemistry.

name: Women's Law Association
description: The Women's Law Association supports the advancement of women in the legal community and society at large, providing resources and support that include a peer mentor program, panel discussions with female leaders in various legal fields, and frequent alu

name: Women's Law Association
description: The purpose of this organization is to support the advancement of women in the legal community and society at large, by providing resources and support that include a peer mentor program, panel discussions with female leaders in various legal fields, and frequent alumni and social events.

name: Women's Ultimate at USC
description: Women's Ultimate at USC is a student organization that helps females foster their ultimate frisbee skills and friendships through regular practices and tournaments.

name: WomenSPEAK
description: WomenSPEAK aims to empower women through dialogue events and volunteering. Twice a month, we host dialogue events and we also partner with the Downtown Women's Center to teach homeless women on Skid Row financial literacy.

name: Womxn of Color Collective
description: WOCC is an inclusive and empowering coalition that celebrates the sisterhood and solidarity among womxn of color who embody diversity and excellence. We put on academic, social, political, and community service events. Each event provides mentorship and networking opportunities to WOC attorneys in the community.

name: Womxn RISE Pre-Health Organization
description: The mission of this organization is to support and empower womxn in pre-health by increasing representation and inclusiveness, developing academic and professional growth, and providing resources, mentoring, volunteer, and networking opportunities.

name: WOODLUMS
description: The purpose of this organization is to address harms of environmental racism and exclusion by organizing nature-focused activities and trips for Black students and centering community building, healing, sovereignty, and kinship with earthly co-inhabitants.

name: WorkBench SC
description: WorkBench is a an on-campus venture studio that promotes the lean growth of ventures and fosters collaboration among the next generation of entrepreneurs at USC.

name: World Renowned Research Methods
description: As a member of WRRM, students will learn about academic research. The nature of WRRM is to promote research vitality and interest amongst undergraduates. WRRM aims to discuss new scientific literature, explore a variety of scientific interests, and promote scientific engagement.

name: WorldMed @ UPC
description: In 2008, the WorldMed at USC: A Global Health Initiative (WorldMed) was founded by graduates of the inaugural class of the Master of Science in Global Medicine Program. In 2016, WorldMed opened a new chapter at the undergraduate campus (WorldMed @ UPC). The mission of WorldMed @ UPC is to bring together a robust and diverse community of undergraduate, graduate, and medical students, physicians, and faculty members of the Keck School of Medicine of USC who are eager to understand, discuss, and tackle the critical issues in global medicine. As a response to the pressing need for a comprehensive

name: WorldMed at USC: A Global Health Initiative
description: Our organization is seeking out highly-motivated and well-rounded individuals at USC who have an interest in global medicine. The goal of our organization is to promote awareness of global health issues in our communities and become leaders in our field.

name: Worldwide Friends
description: The purpose of this organization is to promote friendship between international students and Christians in order to share a Biblical understanding of God's love. To give students the opportunity to develop friendships with each other. To provide help with felt needs, cultural understanding and opportunity for dialogue. To provide social gatherings, activities, trips and special events in order to build relationships and encourage students new to the organization to participate. To provide opportunity for those who are interested in studying the Bible.

name: Wrigley Ambassadors Program
description: Hello! The Wrigley Ambassadors work to catalyze and facilitate integrated change across USC. We recognize that sustainability is everyone's story and requires unprecedented collaboration. Vague understandings of environmental problems is not enough, an...

name: Write Owls
description: To create a writing space that gives participants enough structure to gain inspiration, and enough freedom to experiment.

name: Writers-Actors Guild
description: WAG is a student-formed, student-run organization for students who want to get more involved with Screenwriting, Playwriting, and Acting, who may not have as much experience with production access to be able to jump into a project on their own.

name: Wrongful Convictions Club SC
description: The Wrongful Convictions Club's mission is to advocate for innocent people behind bars, raise funds for pro bono law cases and exoneree rehabilitation, and educate the community on wrongful conviction sentencing.

name: Wuchang Detective Riddles Club
description: Wuchang Detective Riddles Club is the only club at USC that brings the real experience of the “Murder Mysteries” detective game. We are going to host introduction events of the game, offer real time demonstrations and accept game appointments from all US

name: XPressions Dance Company
description: Xpressions Dance Company is a student-run dance organization, showcasing styles including contemporary, jazz, hip hop, lyrical and more. Each semester, Xpressions holds a performance in Bovard Auditorium, featuring exclusively student-choreographed pieces. Xpressions forms a sense of community, bringing people from all backgrounds and styles together to show support and love for USC dancers and students.

name: Yadavary Wellness and Health Inc. USC
description: Yadavary aims to provide wellness and help to the homeless surrounding USC. Yadavary wants to specifically aid with Opioid overdose issues in these communities and conduct research to bring greater awareness of this population.

name: YewSC Surf Club
description: The YewSC Surf club is here to promote the stoke of surfing and bring together a community of people who share a common love of the sport and all things ocean.

name: Young Americans for Freedom at the University of Southern California
description: Young Americans for Freedom is dedicated to preserving and promoting the timeless principles of limited government, free enterprise, individual responsibility, and traditional social values.

name: Young Democratic Socialists of America at USC
description: Young Democratic Socialist of America is the youth section of the Democratic Socialists of America, a big tent socialist organization with chapters across the United States. Our USC chapter focuses on political education and on-campus activism and coor...

name: Young Life USC
description: Young Life College at USC meets students where they are, without judgment, by accepting them exactly where they are. No matter what their religious background or faith journey, we invite students to be a part of our large “club” meetings where students...

name: Young Researchers Program
description: The Young Researchers Program invites high school students from surrounding neighborhoods to conduct STEM research on USC campus for a summer. The neighborhoods surrounding USC's UPC campus are predominantly composed of Black, Latinx, and/or low socioeconomic status. By recruiting from these neighborhoods and high schools, YRP helps to increase the presence of underrepresented groups in STEM. A large part of our program focuses on college preparedness, and >90% of our previous students have committed to a 4 year college with a STEM degree.

name: Youth Evangelical Fellowship at the University of Southern California
description: We are a group of proactive, outreaching Christians and seekers, whose youth and passion are spent on bringing glory to God’s name.

name: Youth Health Leadership Program
description: The Youth Health Leadership Program aims to reduce obesity in South Los Angeles by empowering minority youth to become community health promoters.

name: ZAP
description: The mission of this organization is to act as a communal space for Media Arts and Practice majors, minors, and others to collaborate on projects together and foster a stronger community within the program.

name: ZdC Cinema and Media Studies Graduate Association
description: ZdC represents the academic and professional interests of graduate students in the Cinema and Media Studies department, at the School of Cinematic Arts. We organise book talks with academics, as well as First Forum, the graduate student conference.

name: Zeher
description: Zeher is a national award-winning Bollywood Fusion dance team from Los Angeles. We strive to bring South-Asian culture to the American collegiate stage. Our team is made up of people from around the globe, encompassing both undergraduate and masters students.

name: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Inc.
description: For over 100 years, members of Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Inc. have upheld our Founders’ vision, setting ourselves apart as an organization built on the ideals of Scholarship, Service, Sisterhood, and Finer Womanhood. While on campus, Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Inc. Gamma Lambda Chapter exemplifies nothing but excellence in the areas of scholastic and sorority achievement.

name: Zeta Phi Rho Fraternity
description: Zeta Phi Rho is a multi-cultural fraternity that takes pride in its strong brotherhood, and constantly strives to maintain the title of distinguished gentlemen.

name: Zion Fellowship
description: Zion Fellowship is a Christian community founded by Chinese students at USC. For the past 14 years, we have grown together in God's love. Join us every Thursday on campus at URC 108 for an evening of fellowship featuring dinner, games, Bible study, and an inspiring keynote message.

name: Zodiac Society
description: A tight-knit social organization consisted of diverse students from various backgrounds, bearing unique experiences, all connected by a shared appreciation towards self-expression and cultural differences through creative outlets.
